<thought>Only chlorine shows a clear M+2 peak at ~33% of the base peak, matching its characteristic 3:1 isotopic ratio. No other element shows a distinctive pattern (e.g., bromine's 1:1 M+2, sulfur's small ~4% M+2). Thus chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
